[Shot 1] A medium-wide full-body side view shows bobo <Subject 2> on the left and 99 <Subject 1> on the right, already jogging together from left to right along the beige park path. The rabbit is about half a body length ahead; their bodies remain separate and their whole heads, ears, hands, legs and shoes are visible. The camera tracks smoothly to the right at their jogging speed so both stay centered while trees and flowers pass slowly to the left behind them. Over the entire five seconds both characters perform a continuous comfortable jog: their left and right feet alternate contact with the ground, knees bend in coherent short strides, opposite arms swing naturally, and the rabbit's ears bounce gently. Their heads stay recognizable and their original clothes retain their shapes and colors. They exchange a quick cheerful sideways glance near the middle while continuing forward at the same pace, then look ahead again. The shot ends while both are still jogging together. Soft rhythmic shoe taps match the footfalls; both remain silent.

Regular light footsteps alternate against the dry path, with faint leaf rustle and distant bird calls. The characters are silent; there is no speech, singing or narration.
